title: How Do I: Choose the Right AI Assistant for AL Development?
summary: When choosing an AI assistant for AL development, GitHub Copilot in VS Code excels for code generation with codebase context, while Claude.ai or Claude desktop offer better value for reasoning-heavy tasks like architecture and error analysis due to frontier model access without Copilot cost multipliers. The decision depends on the task type and the new usage-based billing model effective June 2026.
key_points: GitHub Copilot has structural advantage in VS Code due to editor integration and access to workspace symbols and AL objects
Claude.ai and Claude desktop app provide frontier reasoning models without Copilot multipliers, making them cheaper for complex analysis and architecture work
Pricing multipliers vary significantly by model: Haiku at 0.33x, Sonnet at 1x, and Opus at 27x under Copilot's usage-based billing
Different AI tools suit different workflows: Copilot for inline completions, Claude for reasoning, and Copilot Agent for multi-file refactoring
The June 1 pricing change makes the cost of frontier models inside Copilot visible and may justify moving reasoning work to separate tools

quotes.text: The right tool depends on the task, not on loyalty to a single subscription.
quotes.why_it_matters: Core principle for selecting the most economical and effective AI tool for different development activities
